name: surfaces
title: Depth utilities (+ opt-in glass)
summary: depth-card, depth-inset and depth-band: static, token-driven elevation that survives focus rings and prints flat. Plus an opt-in, budget-aware .glass.
when: Flat cards feel lifeless and the design wants physical depth without heavy shadows or blur. Glass only when the brief explicitly calls for it.
next: Add depth-card to framed content (photos, offers), depth-inset to inputs, depth-band to full-width sections.
.glass is on the anti-slop ban list by default: use it only if the brief needs it, and say why in .design/brief.md.
